data.headline: Managing Partner, LionStone Resources
data.about: At LionStone Resources, my current focus is on maximizing the strategic value of physical commodities through innovative financial risk management and commodities optimization strategies. Leveraging a deep understanding of investment management & finance, my recent work involves driving growth and optimizing operations within the commodities sector.
